slot.brief: Which statements about photochemical smog / ozone depletion (role of NO2, PAN, CFCs, radical chain) are correct; identify the wrong statement.

stem: Which statement about photochemical smog and ozone depletion is incorrect?
options: Peroxyacetyl nitrate is an eye irritant found in photochemical smog.
Photolysis of $\text{NO}_2$ can lead to the formation of ozone in the troposphere.
Chlorine radicals released from CFCs can catalytically destroy stratospheric ozone.
Photochemical smog forms most readily under cool, cloudy conditions.

verdicts.working: Photochemical smog forms most readily in warm, sunny conditions, so (D) is incorrect. (A)–(C) are correct.

working:
Photochemical smog forms readily in warm, sunny conditions with stagnant air; sunlight drives the reactions.
